name: Mboa Sawa – Dictionnaire duala
license: No licence stated. Footer: "© 2026 byCamerfeeling / Mboasawa" and "All content cited is derived from their respective sources". No terms-of-use page found (checked 2026-11-13). Treat as copyrighted: entries are kept as pending research data with a link to each page; ask the owners for permission before any redistribution beyond this project.
notes: Inspected 2026-11-13/14. robots.txt (User-agent: *) only disallows /application/, /development/, /externals/, /temporary/. The WordPress sitemap (wp-sitemap-posts-dictionnaire-1..4.xml) lists 7,461 word pages, but the A–Z letter navigation reaches only part of them: 1,146 words start with ɓ (no letter button) and the B and D pages show only a few words. The complete dictionary is read through the site's public WordPress REST API (/fr/wp-json/wp/v2/dictionnaire, 100 words per request, ≥ 5 s apart): title = Duala headword, content = "French gloss###examples". Pairs are inverted (French → Duala). Examples mix Duala and French without a separator (the site itself marks them "à vérifier"): kept verbatim in the entry's example field, never split or imported as translations. The source often writes ę and q where AGLC uses ɛ and ɔ (probably an old font substitution): kept exactly as written, not converted. Editorial process unknown; reliability left at unknown until checked against Helmlinger (1972). Extractor: packages/linguistic-knowledge/src/ingestion/sites/mboasawa.ts; command: pnpm ingest:site --site mboasawa-api.

name: Kemelang – Duala
license: Not open. robots.txt states: "Automated scraping of Kemelang data is strictly restricted. If you wish to access our dictionary datasets, audio corpora, or APIs for commercial or research purposes, please contact us" (contact@kemelang.com).
notes: NOT EXTRACTED. Inspected 2026-11-13: robots.txt blocks AI agents by name (including claude, anthropic, ClaudeBot, Claude-User) with Disallow: / and restricts automated scraping for everyone; a dataset page exists (/dictionary/datasets/download) but access must be requested from the owners. Dictionary pages /dictionnaires/duala/<mot>/ list a Duala headword with several French glosses. Only robots.txt and the /duala/ landing page were fetched for this assessment.

name: Helmlinger, P. (1972). Dictionnaire duala-français, suivi d'un lexique français-duala. Paris: Klincksieck.
license: Copyrighted print work. Only short verified entries may be transcribed with citation; no bulk reproduction.
notes: Standard academic Duala–French dictionary (664 pages) cited by Omniglot, Lexilogos and the Basel Mission Archives. Recommended as the primary reference for linguist verification of entries. Not available in digital form in this project.

name: Ittmann, J., ed. Kähler-Meyer, E. (1976). Wörterbuch der Duala-Sprache / Dictionnaire de la langue duala / Dictionary of the Duala language. Berlin: Dietrich Reimer.
notes: Four-language academic dictionary (675 pages). Reviewers note some missing or erroneous tone marks. Useful secondary reference for linguists.

name: Ittmann, J. (1978). Grammaire du duala (French translation of Grammatik des Duala, 1939). Douala: Collège Libermann.
license: Copyrighted print work. Grammar rules may be summarised in the project's own words with citation.
notes: Reference grammar listed by Glottolog (reference id 80392). Grammar rules entered manually from this work should be recorded with page references in the `reference` field.

name: Wiktionary – Duala entries (fr.wiktionary.org Catégorie:douala, en.wiktionary.org Category:Duala lemmas)
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike required). Attribution: Wiktionary / Wiktionnaire contributors; each entry links to its page and records the revision id in its note. Entries from this source in data/knowledge/douala.json are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Read through the MediaWiki Action API (wikitext), never HTML. Duala entries: fr "Catégorie:douala", en "Category:Duala lemmas" (definitions and usage examples with their translation). Translation tables: fr "Catégorie:Traductions en douala" (French pages with {{trad|dua|…}}), en "Category:Terms with Duala translations" (English pages with {{t|dua|…}}); translations Wiktionary flags as unchecked ({{t-check}}, {{checktrans-top}}) are skipped. API etiquette: serial requests, descriptive User-Agent with a contact URL, maxlag=5, ≥ 3.5 s apart. Community-edited: AGLC and Meinhof spellings coexist and are kept as written. Commands: pnpm ingest:site --site wiktionary-fr | wiktionary-en | wiktionary-fr-translations | wiktionary-en-translations.

name: Manual entries by project linguists
license: Project licence (MIT) for entries authored by the project team.
notes: Use this source for vocabulary, expressions and grammar rules typed by native speakers and linguists through the admin interface or the ingest CLI. Entries still start as `pending` and must be approved.

name: Wikipédia – « Duala (langue) » (fr) and « Duala language » (en)
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution and share-alike). Contributors of Wikipédia / Wikipedia.
notes: Read 2026-11-14 through the MediaWiki API (fr revision 241045385, en revision 1359233633). The French article cites Nseme (1998), Helmlinger (1972) and duala.douala.free.fr for its tables (pronouns, verbal prefixes, demonstratives, noun-class prefixes, basic words, months, body parts, phrases, numbers). Tables imported as pending entries; grammar summarised in data/knowledge/grammaire-douala.md. Command: pnpm ingest:site --site wikipedia-fr.

name: WALS Online – Duala (wals_code dua), Dryer & Haspelmath (eds.), 2013
license: CC BY 4.0 (WALS Online, Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology). Values read from the CLDF release cldf-datasets/wals v2020.4.
notes: 28 feature values for Duala (word order SVO, noun–adjective, noun–genitive, demonstrative–noun, preverbal negative particle, double-object 'give', 'exceed' comparative…), each citing Ittmann (1939, 1978), Meinhof (1912) or Biloa (1993). Used for the grammar sheet only (no vocabulary).
